## Hard rules that bite (full lists: AGENTS.md, docs/invariants.md)
- Agents never `git commit`/`push`; the operator commits. **One commit per card** (two-slice
  handovers failed twice — worklog 2026-07-21). Message = text only, never a `git commit`
  command; no AI/co-author trailers; diff every message against `git diff --cached --stat`.
- **Executors never draft commit messages or next-session prompts** (Role rule, task-queue.md).
- Never stage `.claude/` or `data/`; never edit `plans/master-plan.md`/
  `solana-crypto-trader-plan.md` (lockstep pair); no keys/signing/submit/network before M8/M9's
  separate explicit approval; determinism + fixed-point money non-negotiable; review swarms only
  with operator go-ahead, `model: 'sonnet'` low effort.
- GATE = `bash scripts/gate.sh` run unprompted, counts pasted never transcribed; handoff
  baselines only via `bash scripts/handoff-baselines.sh`.
